threads.text: For Kwara State, court no fit just eject tenant unless dem satisfy say suitable alternative accommodation dey for ground. E must fit the tenant pocket and work place. You be landlord or tenant?
threads.evening: In Kwara, rushing to eject a tenant without checking court requirements can freeze your application for months.

short.title: Deduct caution fee blindly. Pay twice in court.
short.hook_sub: Landlords lose disputes over unfair deductions.
short.hook_say: When a tenant packs out, taking caution money without proof turns into an expensive court loss. Know what qualifies before you touch the balance.

tips.sub: Routine fading walls are landlord duty
tips.say: Do not charge the tenant for normal aging of the flat. Routine fading and minor scuffs belong to property maintenance, not the tenant deposit.

tips.sub: Cracked sinks and holes require repair
tips.say: Legitimate deductions cover visible structural damage caused by neglect. Cracked sinks, broken doors, and destroyed fittings qualify for an itemised bill.

tips.sub: Estimate figures will fail in dispute
tips.say: Never invent random amounts when returning funds. Present actual vendor receipts showing exact artisan costs and replacement parts purchased.
Return whatever balance remains promptly after exit inspection. Delaying payment without genuine justification makes you liable before the tribunal.

short.hook_text:
